needed.evidence: The left side of the road is an open paved area with parked cars and stacked goods, with no purpose-built sidewalk or continuous path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk along the left edge of the road, separated from the vehicle lane by a kerb.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is an open paved area in front of the shop, with no purpose-built sidewalk or continuous path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk along the right edge of the road, providing a safe path for pedestrians to the shop entrance.

needed.evidence: A marked zebra crossing is visible on the road, but it is not a purpose-built facility like a signalised or raised crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install a raised pedestrian crossing at the marked zebra crossing to slow traffic and improve visibility for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The marked zebra crossing is on a wide, unlit road with no refuge, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians and for pedestrians to cross safely.
needed.suggestion: Install a raised pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island at the marked zebra crossing to improve safety and visibility.

needed.evidence: There are no visible dropped kerbs at the marked zebra crossing, which would make it difficult for pedestrians, especially those with mobility issues, to cross.
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the marked zebra crossing to provide a smooth transition for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road, which would make it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians and other road users at night.
needed.suggestion: Install street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users, especially at night.
